description: THE PER-FAMILY STATUS BLOCK — the field schema for scripts/report_family_status.sh (task-tree leaf DONE-BAR-VISIBILITY.1). Origin, verbatim, director 2026-08-30: 'I have no idea for each parser the amount of work to reach full completion (Done). I have no idea or clue about (1) the amount of test corpus that are passing (2) a synthesis about what's left to be done to reach the Done status.' Every field below answers one of those questions FROM A NAMED PRODUCER. A field with no producer is not a field: it is prose, and LIVE-MEANS-LIVE.1a measured what prose status does here -- 25 of 61 hand-maintained fields were simply wrong. The producer READS this file and refuses when the rendered field set and this schema's field set are not EQUAL, in either direction, so a field cannot be added here without being rendered nor rendered without being declared.

policy.producer: The exact command or tracked artifact the field's value comes from. It must be runnable by a reader; 'derived from the tree' is not a producer.
policy.state: `derived` = a producer answers it today. `not_measured` = nothing answers it yet, and the field is rendered as NOT MEASURED with its owing leaf, never as a blank or a zero (docs/decisions/feedback_a_check_that_cannot_run_must_say_so.md).
policy.owed_by: Required when state is `not_measured`: the task-tree leaf id that owes the producer. A gap with no owner is a gap nobody is going to close (docs/decisions/feedback_every_finding_is_owned_and_scheduled_never_just_logged.md).
policy.surfaces: Where the field is rendered. `chat` = the brief form the engineer reports in completion messages. `book` = the thorough form published into the family's book, and the ONLY half that --check holds equal to a fresh derivation.
policy.why_book_is_a_subset: ⛔ THE BOOK HALF IS PORTABLE-ONLY, AND THAT IS A CORRECTNESS PROPERTY, NOT A SIMPLIFICATION. Legs 1 and the green-NOW half of leg 2 rest on gate artifacts under rust/target/, which is UNTRACKED: the same commit reads `artifact STALE` on the machine that ran the gate and `no artifact on this machine` on a fresh clone. A published block carrying either sentence would make --check FAIL for every reader who did not run the gate first -- a gate that fails on a clean clone of its own repository. So the book publishes the derivation run TRACKED-ONLY (via the audit's PGEN_DONE_BAR_TARGET_DIR seam, pointed at an empty directory), which is what the repository itself proves to any reader, and the chat form adds this machine's artifact readings on top. One derivation, one run, two renderings -- the book half is the subset every clone agrees on.
policy.corpus_census: Per-family wiring for the corpus fields: the gate that proves the census artifacts are FRESH, the tracked artifacts the counts are read from, and the manifest denominator they are counted against. A family absent from this map renders the corpus fields as NOT MEASURED with `owed_by`. ⭐ The freshness gate is invoked, never re-implemented: the counts are read from the TRACKED artifact and the derived tuple is then CROSS-CHECKED against the tuple that gate prints, so an arithmetic drift between the two refuses instead of publishing. ⭐ `grammar_semantic_identity_row` (SV-CORPUS-GRAD.13r) names the report's SEMANTIC grammar row (sha256 of the EBNF frontend's raw_ast envelope, `check_baseline_identity.sh --digest ebnf_raw_ast`); when declared and present, the census gate's grammar arm keys on it, so a comment-only grammar edit is a NOTE instead of a blocked commit and two corpus re-measures — while any production/terminal/annotation change still fails. Absent row or absent digester falls back to the byte row, loudly.
policy.tree_attribution: Which parser family, if any, a task tree's remaining work belongs to. ⛔ CLOSED AND TWO-SIDED over the rows of docs/TASK_TREE.md, on the done-bar register's `grammar_dispositions` model: a tree row with no attribution REFUSES, and an attribution naming no row REFUSES. A one-shot census is a snapshot; a closed population is a mechanism, and it is what stops the roster silently re-growing. ⛔ THE OPEN/CLOSED VERDICT IS TWO-ARMED, because both arms are prose: the index row's Status cell and the tree file's own Metadata Status. Measured 2026-08-30, they DISAGREE on 3 of 113 trees (EBNF-BOOK, RGX-0090, RGX-0091 -- each an index row reading done over a tree file reading active), so a list built on either arm alone is wrong three times. ⛔ It read FOUR until the reader was corrected: the row's own status is the FIRST status token in the cell, and taking ANY open word in the cell manufactured a fourth disagreement out of a LEAF described as blocked deep inside VERILOG-2005-PROFILE's narration. A safe-polarity default is still a measurement. A disagreement is reported DISPUTED and counted OPEN; a Status cell carrying no recognisable status word is counted OPEN and named. The safe polarity for a remaining-work list is to over-report, never to quietly drop work.
policy.corpus_state: WHY a family publishes no corpus count, per family, with the leaf that owes one. ⛔ THE CLASS IS NOT HAND-TYPED: the producer DERIVES it from the done-bar register (`language_owner` x whether `corpus_roots` is empty x whether a census is wired here) and REFUSES when the derived class and the declared class disagree. Two arms, independently produced -- declaring the class alone would let it drift from the register the moment a corpus is wired, which is exactly the rot this tree exists to end. ⛔ `NOT MEASURED` is never a blank and never a zero (docs/decisions/feedback_a_check_that_cannot_run_must_say_so.md), and it always names an owner (docs/decisions/feedback_every_finding_is_owned_and_scheduled_never_just_logged.md). `last_measured_in` is a POINTER to the leaf holding the last measurement, never a copy of its number: a number copied here is a number that rots (DERIVED_STATE_CONTAINMENT R1/R3).
policy.leg3_declared_reading: DONE-BAR.3g (2026-10-08): the corpus table above is the RAW lane; leg 3's assertion reads each row under its DECLARED reading (DONE-BAR.3f), so the distance the director can watch is the burnable count under that reading, not the raw no-verdict count. The field is rendered from the register's tracked_assertion_command - the same command the done-bar audit evaluates pass_query over - never from a second derivation, and it is cross-checked against the census gate's own tuple under the pipeline so the two instruments cannot publish different numbers for one reading.

claimed_status.question: What does PGEN CLAIM this family's status is?

language_owner.question: Who defines the language, and therefore which `Provisional` qualifier this family can ever hold?

bar_leg_1.question: Leg 1 of the `Done` bar - do the family's own generated stimuli close the loop with ZERO residual actionable-target debt?

bar_leg_2.question: Leg 2 - is every gate covering this family green NOW, and is each one actually invoked by something?

bar_leg_3.question: Leg 3 - is an officially-recognized external corpus asserted as a PASS by a conformance gate?

leg3_declared_reading.question: Under the reading leg 3 actually asserts (DONE-BAR.3f) - the preprocess->parse pipeline's re-adjudication for a row the raw lane defers to it, the raw class otherwise - how many rows are adjudicated, how many are permanently unadjudicable (named and bounded), and how many still await a verdict? The three sum to the denominator; the last is the distance leg 3 measures.
leg3_declared_reading.producer: rust/test_data/grammar_quality/done_bar_family_register_v0.json :: families.<family>.leg3_surface.tracked_assertion_command (SystemVerilog: python3 stimuli/sv/corpus_conformance_compare.py --assert-tracked ... --assert-tracked-v2005 ...), its JSON read per lane; the sv_2017 lane's declared adjudicated/routed/no-verdict/bar CROSS-CHECKED against the tuple under the pipeline that the family's corpus freshness gate prints (corpus_census.<family>.pipeline_tuple_marker), and rows == adjudicated + permanent + burnable held, else refused. A family whose leg3_surface declares no tracked_assertion_command renders NOT MEASURED with the owing leaf (DONE-BAR.3), never a blank.

local_gate_state.question: And on THIS machine, right now - what do the gate artifacts under rust/target/ actually say?

corpus_rows.question: How large is the corpus this family is judged against, and how much of it carries a verdict at all?
corpus_rows.producer: corpus_census[<family>] when a census is wired; otherwise the corpus_state class DERIVED from the done-bar register, which says WHY there is no count and names the leaf that owes one

corpus_passing.question: How many corpus rows does the parser answer exactly the way the answer key says?
corpus_passing.producer: corpus_census[<family>] when a census is wired; otherwise the corpus_state class DERIVED from the done-bar register, which says WHY there is no count and names the leaf that owes one

known_defects.question: How many rows diverge from the key with NO explanation - the defect bar itself?
known_defects.producer: corpus_census[<family>] when a census is wired; otherwise the corpus_state class DERIVED from the done-bar register, which says WHY there is no count and names the leaf that owes one

remaining_work.question: What is the finite list of work between here and `Done`, and who owns each item?
remaining_work.producer: docs/TASK_TREE.md (the tree index) x `tree_attribution` in this file - the OPEN trees attributed to the family, each verdict cross-checked against that tree file's own Metadata Status

systemverilog.denominator: every row of the SystemVerilog corpus adjudication manifests over stimuli/sv/subs + stimuli/sv/uvm
systemverilog.pipeline_tuple_legend: adjudicated/routed/no-verdict/dark/axis-2-bar under the pipeline (the declared reading of the sv_2017 lane, SVPP-EXPANSION.6c.1)

systemverilog_raw_parse.denominator: every .sv / .svh / .v file under the fourteen vendored SystemVerilog corpora in stimuli/sv/subs plus the folded uvm-core tree in stimuli/sv/uvm
systemverilog_raw_parse.tuple_legend: files/pass/fail/timeout/crash; RAW parse outcomes under --profile sv_2017, no answer key
systemverilog_raw_parse.answer_key: none here -- these are RAW parse outcomes and a parse-FAIL is frequently the CORRECT outcome. The SystemVerilog ANSWER KEY lives in the adjudication manifests and is published as the `systemverilog` verdict_coverage entry above; this entry exists because that one carries NO identity row, so nothing could re-hash the grammar the numbers describe (SV-CORPUS-GRAD.13j).

systemverilog_v2005_raw_parse.denominator: every row of stimuli/sv/characterization/v2005_lane_files.tsv -- the ADJUDICATOR-DERIVED lane membership list, which is what the producer reads. This lane does NOT walk a directory, so `denominator_source` is `lane_list` and not `filesystem`: re-counting stimuli/sv/subs for it would answer a different question than the producer asked, and measured it disagrees on every suite of the lane (356/1909/341 published against 1266/3799/953 walked).
systemverilog_v2005_raw_parse.tuple_legend: files/pass/fail/timeout/crash; RAW parse outcomes under --profile verilog_2005, no answer key
systemverilog_v2005_raw_parse.answer_key: none here -- RAW parse outcomes under the strict verilog_2005 profile, and a parse-FAIL is frequently the CORRECT outcome (the lane deliberately contains SystemVerilog-only constructs a 1364-2005 parser must reject). The v2005 ANSWER KEY lives in stimuli/sv/characterization/adjudication_manifest_v2005.tsv and is published through the `systemverilog` verdict_coverage entry; this entry exists so the lane's RAW report carries an identity row something re-hashes (SV-CORPUS-GRAD.13m).

systemverilog_sv2023_raw_parse.denominator: every .sv / .svh / .v file under the fourteen vendored SystemVerilog corpora in stimuli/sv/subs plus the folded uvm-core tree in stimuli/sv/uvm -- the SAME population as systemverilog_raw_parse, re-parsed under --profile sv_2023 (SV-CORPUS-GRAD.14a)
systemverilog_sv2023_raw_parse.tuple_legend: files/pass/fail/timeout/crash; RAW parse outcomes under --profile sv_2023, no answer key
systemverilog_sv2023_raw_parse.answer_key: none here -- RAW parse outcomes under the IEEE 1800-2023 profile over the same files the sv_2017 lane parses. The per-file sv_2017 x sv_2023 verdict census (docs/tasks/artifacts/sv_corpus_grad/sv2023_lane/census.py) names every row whose verdict differs between the two editions; a 2023-lane ANSWER KEY is SV-CORPUS-GRAD.14b, not this entry (SV-CORPUS-GRAD.14a).

vhdl.denominator: every .vhd / .vhdl file under the ten vendored VHDL corpora in stimuli/vhdl/subs
vhdl.tuple_legend: files/pass/fail/timeout/crash; RAW parse outcomes, no answer key
vhdl.answer_key: none -- these are RAW parse outcomes. Many corpus files are INTENTIONALLY invalid (GHDL `gna` bug regressions, non-compliant fixtures), so a parse-FAIL is frequently the CORRECT outcome. A raw pass rate is NOT an adjudicated one and this producer must never render it as though a key existed; the adjudication is owed by CORPUS-GRAD-ALL.2.

regex.tuple_legend: cells/matches/false-accepts/false-rejects; the answer key is PCRE2's own compile verdicts
regex.denominator: every pattern spec pcre2test 10.47 declares in testdata/testinput2 that the normalizer can pair soundly with its recorded verdict
regex.answer_key: PCRE2 10.47's own recorded compile verdict for each pattern -- a REAL answer key, so unlike the VHDL census this pass share IS a conformance share. 50 of the 2 239 detected pattern specs are DECLINED rather than answered (48 carry a suffix modifier under which the raw pattern text is not what pcre2_compile sees, 2 fail UTF-8 decoding); they are counted in the denominator and named, never dropped.

vocabulary.<family>: one of the `families` keys of done_bar_family_register_v0.json - this tree's remaining work is work on THAT parser
vocabulary.cross-cutting: engine, codegen, annotation, stimuli or corpus-doctrine work that can gate ANY family. Counted for every family, but reported as a COUNT rather than inlined, so a family's own list stays readable
vocabulary.process: governance, continuity, documentation, ops and repo hygiene. Real work, but not on any parser's path to `Done`
vocabulary.future-family: a parser family PGEN does not ship yet (Phase S and later). No current family's bar depends on it
vocabulary.platform: platform expansion around the parsers - a linter, an elaborator workbench, MCP control - rather than a parser

classes.census_wired: a census producer and a freshness gate exist; the counts are DERIVED on every render (see `corpus_census`)
classes.corpus_wired_no_census: the register declares external corpus roots, but no TRACKED census turns them into counts a reader can re-derive
classes.no_corpus_wired: the language is standardized, so a corpus exists in the world, but none is wired into this repository. An UNMET leg, never an inapplicable one
classes.no_third_party_corpus: the language is authored by PGEN itself, so no third-party corpus exists or ever will. NOT a measurement gap -- leg 3 is unreachable by construction and the qualifier is `Provisional (ceiling)`
classes.ownership_unadjudicated: whether a corpus for the full standard counts against this SUBSET language is an open ruling; until it is made, a corpus count would be measured against a denominator nobody has agreed to

vhdl.note: ⛔ WIRED IS NOT ADJUDICATED. DONE-BAR-VISIBILITY.3b re-measured the census on HEAD and put CORPUS-CENSUS-CURRENCY behind it, so the COUNTS are now derived on every render and cannot rot -- but the corpus still has NO answer key: nothing says which of these files SHOULD parse, and many are intentionally invalid, so a parse-FAIL is frequently the CORRECT outcome. The pass rate is therefore RAW and moves leg 3 not at all; the adjudication is owed by CORPUS-GRAD-ALL.2. ⭐ The number this replaced is why the doctrine exists: the previously published 4 031 / 9 689 was superseded by .2.2/.2.3 to 4 335 / 9 385, which had itself gone stale to 4 370 / 9 350 -- 22 days and 72 engine commits with nothing asking it to re-run.

regex.note: ⭐ The one family whose corpus has a REAL answer key that is re-derivable from tracked inputs: PCRE2 10.47's own recorded compile verdicts. DONE-BAR-VISIBILITY.3c made the normalizer's output reproducible (its `outputs` block recorded ABSOLUTE paths into a foreign checkout, so the tracked summary was a function of whose machine ran it) and wired CORPUS-CENSUS-CURRENCY over it, which re-runs the normalizer into a scratch directory in 0.11 s and compares byte-for-byte. ⚠️ HONEST LIMIT: the VERDICT half is anchor-held, not re-executed per commit -- producing it needs a cargo build plus a run over every case (80 s, 5.5 GB peak). It was re-measured on HEAD for this leaf and read 2189/1879/262/48, EXACTLY the published anchor.
